an5.55:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an5.55:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ ubho mātāputtā vassāvāsaṃ upagamiṃsu
an5.55:1.10: te otiṇṇacittā sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseviṃsu.
an5.55:2.1: athakho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
an5.55:2.2: idha bhante sāvatthiyaṃ ubho mātāputtā vassāvāsaṃ upagamiṃsu
an5.55:2.3: bhikkhu ca bhikkhunī ca te aññamaññassa abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmā ahesuṃ mātāpi puttassa abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmā ahosi puttopi mātaraṃ abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmo ahosi
an5.55:2.4: tesaṃ abhiṇhaṃ dassanā saṃsaggo ahosi saṃsagge sati vissāso ahosi vissāse sati otāro ahosi te otiṇṇacittā sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseviṃsūti
an5.55:3.2: na mātā putte sārajjati putto vā pana mātarīti
an5.55:3.3: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekarūpaṃpi samanupassāmi evaṃ rajanīyaṃ evaṃ kamanīyaṃ evaṃ madanīyaṃ evaṃ bandhanīyaṃ evaṃ mucchanīyaṃ evaṃ antarāyakaraṃ anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthīrūpaṃ
an5.55:3.4: itthīrūpe bhikkhave sattā rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā
an5.55:4.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekasaddaṃpi … ekagandhaṃpi … ekarasaṃpi … ekaphoṭṭhabbaṃpi samanupassāmi evaṃ rajanīyaṃ evaṃ kamanīyaṃ evaṃ madanīyaṃ evaṃ bandhanīyaṃ evaṃ mucchanīyaṃ evaṃ antarāyakaraṃ anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthīphoṭṭhabbo.
an5.55:4.2: itthīphoṭṭhabbe bhikkhave sattā rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā
an5.55:5.1: itthī bhikkhave gacchantīpi purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati
an5.55:5.2: ṭhitāpi nisinnāpi sayānāpi nipannāpi hasantīpi bhaṇantīpi gāyantīpi rodantīpi ugghāṭitāpi matāpi purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
an5.55:5.3: yañhi taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an5.55:5.4: samantapāso mārassāti mātugāmaññeva sammā vadamāno vadeyya
